title: Appraisal Order Update Visit Charge: Market-Conditions Part
content:
## Market-conditions part — Appraisal Order update visit charge

**Clause.** The market-conditions part of the update visit charge compares the appraised value the report states with the property value on the loan file, as a percentage of that property value: when the appraised value is above the property value by less than 1 percent, or is not above it, the update carries a full market-conditions refresh and adds 100 dollars; when it is above by 1 to under 3 percent, a short refresh adds 50 dollars; and a cushion of 3 percent or more adds nothing. The market-conditions part is added into the standard update charge.

**Definition of the cushion.** The cushion is the appraised value on the Appraisal Order (as last revised) less the property value on the Mortgage Loan File the order supports, divided by that property value and expressed as a percentage.

| Cushion | Refresh | Adds (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| Zero or negative (appraised value not above the property value) | Full | 100.00 |
| Above zero and under 1 percent | Full | 100.00 |
| 1 percent to under 3 percent | Short | 50.00 |
| 3 percent or more | None | 0.00 |

**Worked cases (hypothetical property value on the loan file: 500,000.00).**

| Appraised value | Cushion | Adds |
|---|---|---|
| 495,000.00 | negative (not above) | 100.00 |
| 503,000.00 | 0.6 percent | 100.00 |
| 505,000.00 | 1.0 percent | 50.00 |
| 514,000.00 | 2.8 percent | 50.00 |
| 515,000.00 | 3.0 percent | 0.00 |
